facts.fact: The scheme is the PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) scheme of the Ministry of Food Processing Industries
facts.quote: Welcome to PMFME-MOFPI --> Home | Ministry of Food Processing Industries | Government of India

facts.fact: Individual micro food processing units (e.g. pickle, papad) get a credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of the eligible project cost, up to Rs 10 lakh per unit
facts.quote: Individual micro food processing units would be provided credit-linked capital subsidy @35% of the eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of Rs.10.0 lakh per unit.

facts.fact: The subsidy is for upgrading an existing unit or setting up a new unit
facts.quote: would be provided credit-linked capital subsidy @35% of the eligible project cost - maximum of Rs. 10.0 lakhs per unit for upgradation or setting up of new units.

facts.fact: The beneficiary contributes at least 10% of the project cost and the balance is a bank loan, so the subsidy is credit-linked, not a cash grant
facts.quote: Beneficiary contribution should be minimum of 10% of the project cost with balance required fund being loan from Bank.
facts.note: Derived: the quote makes the rest of the cost a bank loan; 'credit-linked' is in fact 2's quote.

facts.fact: The applicant must be above 18 years of age
facts.quote: The individual applicant should be above 18 years of age. No minimum educational qualification of the applicant is required.

facts.fact: No minimum educational qualification is required (MoFPI OM of 18.05.2022)
facts.was: the applicant must have at least Class VIII pass
facts.quote: The individual applicant should be above 18 years of age. No minimum educational qualification of the applicant is required.
facts.note: The OM of 18.05.2022 modifies the 29.06.2020 guidelines 'in supersession to relevant clauses'; the older FAQ (7.12.2021) on the portal still says Class VIII.

facts.fact: Only one person per family (self, spouse, children) can get assistance
facts.quote: No, only one person from one family would be eligible for obtaining financial assistance. The “family” for this purpose would include self, spouse and children.

facts.fact: Individuals, proprietorship and partnership firms, FPOs, NGOs, cooperatives, SHGs and private limited companies are all eligible for the 35% / Rs 10 lakh subsidy
facts.was: the enterprise must be proprietary or partnership and unincorporated
facts.quote: Individuals / Proprietorship / Partnership/ FPOs/ NGOs/ Cooperatives/ SHGs/ Pvt. Ltd. Co. would be provided credit-linked capital subsidy @35% of the eligible project cost
facts.note: Same change in the MoFPI OM of 18.05.2022, para 1(v).

facts.fact: MoFPI pages differ on the fewer-than-10-workers condition: the 2020 guidelines (and 2021 FAQ) require an unincorporated enterprise with fewer than 10 workers, while the 18.05.2022 OM, which supersedes the relevant clauses, makes companies, FPOs and cooperatives eligible and states no worker limit
facts.was: the enterprise must have fewer than 10 workers
facts.quote: The enterprise should be unincorporated and should employ less than 10 workers;

also.quote: Partnership Firms/ Farmer Producer Organizations(FPOs)/ NGOs/ Cooperatives/ SHGs/ Pvt. Ltd. Companies, who have established or propose to establish micro food processing unit, would be eligible for financial assistance under the Scheme.

facts.note: Searched pmfme.mofpi.gov.in What's New / Guidelines (28 Oct 2026): no later notice restating or removing the 10-worker limit.

facts.fact: Land cost is excluded from the eligible project cost
facts.quote: Eligible project cost comprises cost of plant & machinery and technical civil work, but excludes cost of land/ rental or lease work shed.

facts.fact: The eligible project cost covers plant & machinery and technical civil work only; rental or lease of a workshed is excluded
facts.was: a rented or leased workshed can be included in the project cost (lease up to 3 years)
facts.quote: Eligible project cost comprises cost of plant & machinery and technical civil work, but excludes cost of land/ rental or lease work shed.
facts.note: The 2020 guidelines para 4.2(x) and the 2021 FAQ allowed lease rental for up to 3 years; the 18.05.2022 OM supersedes them.

facts.fact: Units making the district's ODOP product are preferred, but other micro enterprises, existing or new, are also considered
facts.quote: While enterprise involved in the product identified in the ODOP of the district will be preferred, other micro enterprises would also be considered for both existing or new micro food processing enterprises.

facts.fact: The subsidy goes into a mirror account and is credited after 3 years if the loan stays standard and the unit operates
facts.quote: The beneficiary needs to pay the EMI on time for the next three years and the unit needs to be operational. Post 3 years, if the loan category is standard, the subsidy amount will be credited to the beneficiary account.

facts.fact: There is no application or processing fee, including for handholding
facts.quote: No, it’s a centrally sponsored scheme, you need not to pay any fees for filling application or any handholding.

facts.fact: A district resource person helps prepare the DPR and get the bank loan
facts.quote: The resource person will assist in the preparation of DPR, taking a bank loan, support for obtaining necessary registration and licenses

facts.fact: SHG members can get seed capital of Rs 40,000 per member, up to Rs 4 lakh per SHG
facts.quote: Seed capital @ Rs. 40,000/- per member of SHG for working capital and purchase of small tools maximum upto 4 Lakhs per SHG.

facts.fact: Groups (FPOs, cooperatives, SHGs etc.) can get 35% up to Rs 3 crore for common infrastructure
facts.quote: would be provided credit linked capital subsidy @35% of the eligible project cost with a maximum of Rs. 3.00 Crore.

facts.fact: Apply online on pmfme.mofpi.gov.in through New User (Applicant) Registration
facts.quote: NEW USER REGISTRATION नया उपयोगकर्ता पंजीकरण REGISTRATION FORM पंजीकरण फॉर्म Select the type of Beneficiary*

behaviour: Gives the PMFME figures with a citation to the PMFME portal / MoFPI guidelines and OM (pmfme.mofpi.gov.in); says it is a bank-loan-linked subsidy (min 10% own contribution, rest bank loan); gives no eligibility verdict; on the worker limit, either mentioning the fewer-than-10-workers condition from the guidelines/FAQ or leaving it out is acceptable, noting the 2022 OM widened eligible entities is best.
fail_if: Says it is a 35% grant without a loan; gives a Rs 10 lakh subsidy regardless of project cost; says 50% or 90% subsidy; says new units are allowed only for ODOP products; says Class VIII pass is required or that only proprietary/partnership firms are eligible (changed by the MoFPI OM of 18.05.2022); says workshed rent can be included in the project cost; asks for fees/agents; confuses it with PMEGP.
summary: Subsidy 35%/Rs 10 lakh, 10% own contribution, mirror account, no fee, SHG/group support confirmed; the MoFPI OM of 18.05.2022 removed the Class VIII rule, widened eligible entities (incl. Pvt Ltd, FPOs, coops) and excluded workshed rent from project cost; the 10-worker limit is a conflict between the 2020 guidelines and that OM.
